parent: Latte at the Lofts (Lofts Coffee Company & Roastery)
notes: The City of Portsmouth lists Lofts Coffee Company & Roastery as a single downtown coffee shop and restaurant; the tie between the legal name Latte at the Lofts and this shop is inferred from the name and city, not from a filing. No headcount was found, but a single-location cafe is very likely under 100 employees.

emp_source: metrics_jobs_retained_max=6 (JobsOhio Inclusion Grant project report); https://www.permapaveredging.com/
notes: Perma Edge Industries makes Perma Paver Edging at 800 Scholz Dr., Vandalia, per its own site; no parent company is named. JobsOhio's project report lists only an Inclusion Grant with 6 jobs retained.

The company site says Products Chemical Company was founded in Cleveland in 1942 and makes cleaning and specialty chemicals at 4005 Clark Ave.; LinkedIn lists it as privately held with 11-50 employees. No parent company or 2023 headcount was found.

UPS Supply Chain Solutions, Inc. (Delaware) is listed in UPS's 2022 Exhibit 21, and UPS's 2022 10-K reports about 536,000 employees. The EDGAR match to Fritz Companies reflects the EIN of the freight forwarder UPS bought in 2001, which became part of this unit.

parent: HSB Services LLC (dba High Road Towing and Recovery)
notes: The Jackson Area Chamber lists HSB Services LLC, dba High Road Towing and Recovery, as a towing firm on US 35 owned by three local partners; Bizapedia shows the LLC filed in Ohio in November 2021. No headcount was found, so the under-100 bucket rests on its being a young, locally owned towing business.

OhioSE's June 2023 release says JDL Rental, LLC is the real estate holding company of Alpha Tire Group, a Hershberger family-owned tire wholesaler founded in 2015 in Barnesville, which retained four jobs and planned six more with a $25,000 Inclusion Grant. The input's GA state is an error; the address is Barnesville, Ohio.
SBIR.gov lists Engineered Products of Ohio, LLC at 4191 Youngstown Kingsville Rd., Cortland, with 5 employees, and LinkedIn shows the RFID maker at 2-10 employees. No parent company was found.

Eurostampa North America in Cincinnati is part of the family-owned Eurostampa group of Bene Vagienna, Italy, which its site says has 7 plants and over 1,300 employees today; the US unit's Form 5500 shows 146 participants in 2015 and 267 in 2019. The 2017 group headcount was not found, so the bucket assumes the group was already above 500 then.

parent: Moriroku Holdings Company, Ltd. (now Moriroku Co., Ltd.)
notes: Greenville Technology Inc. is the Greenville plant of Moriroku Technology North America (the Form 5500 sponsor for this EIN, 1,216 participants in 2019), owned by Tokyo-based Moriroku, which reports 3,873 consolidated employees as of March 2026. The 2018 group headcount was not fetched, so the bucket assumes it was also under 5,000.

emp_source: none found; https://www.privco.com/company/bpi-associates shows no employee data
notes: BPI Associates, LLC was formed in Ohio in March 2010 and is listed in Dublin/Columbus as an engineering or construction firm, but no JobsOhio release, owner or headcount was found in Yahoo, Google News, PrivCo or its parked website. It has no JobsOhio metrics or Form 5500 record, so the under-100 bucket is a best guess.

The blank name is Coshocton Port Authority, 106 South 4th Street, Coshocton, per JobsOhio's FY2014 Form 990 Schedule I (filing 201413189349308116), which lists $22,000 to purchase equipment for workforce training. It is a county port authority, a public body, and no staff count was found, but a county economic development office is very likely under 100.

emp_source: Form 5500 participants for EIN 341145880 (sponsor G&S METAL PRODUCTS CO., INC., OH): 211 in 2015, 215 in 2019, 332 in 2023
notes: G&S Metal Products is a private Cleveland bakeware maker in business since 1949 with plants in Ohio and Connecticut; its own Form 5500 shows 215 participants in 2019. No outside parent was found.

Business directories place J.I.T. Packaging Cincinnati at 1550 Kingsview Dr., Lebanon, and AllBiz's search listing estimates about 70 employees there, with Jeff Jones as president; the directory pages themselves were blocked, so the figure is from the search snippet. A JIT Packaging also operated in Massillon, and whether the two share an owner was not confirmed.

The federal NPI registry (https://npiregistry.cms.hhs.gov/api/?number=1336551316&version=2.1) lists Gentry Health Services Inc, a Medina specialty pharmacy, as doing business as Discount Drug Mart, the private Medina drugstore chain founded in Elyria in 1969 with 78 stores in 2023 per Wikipedia. No headcount was found; the 500-4,999 bucket rests on the store count, so treat it as a best estimate.

Rexam Beverage Can Company (Fremont plant) was the US can unit of London-based Rexam PLC, about 8,000 employees in 2014 per Wikipedia, through the FY2016 grant year; Ball Corporation (Colorado, the EDGAR HQ shown) bought Rexam on June 30, 2016, the last day of that fiscal year (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/9389/000155837016007939/R10.htm). Either owner was well over 5,000 employees.

emp_source: Form 5500 participants for EIN 113158401 (sponsor FISHER HOUSE FOUNDATION, INC., MD): 30 in 2019, 40 in 2023
notes: Fisher House Foundation is a 501(c)(3) charity in Rockville, Maryland that builds lodging for military and veteran families; its Form 5500 shows 30 to 40 plan participants. The $6,000 was a charitable gift, not a business incentive.

Foldedpak is a private Denver die-cut paperboard maker (D&B lists it since 2003) that registered an Ohio entity in 2014 and runs a plant at 263 Milliken Dr., Hebron; directory listings (RocketReach, SignalHire) show only a handful of employees, which likely undercounts plant staff. No headcount for 2014 or 2021 and no JobsOhio release were found, and the Schedule I shows $0 cash.

Tramec Sloan was formed in 2013 when Iola, Kansas-based Tramec, LLC bought Sloan Transportation Products, and it bought Crawford Machine in Galion, Ohio later that year (company history); Kona Equity estimates about 319 employees, and the Galion plant had 107 in 2023 per the Galion Inquirer. Tramec also owns fastener and plastics units, so the whole group may have passed 500, and Mergr lists Wells Fargo and High Street Capital as investors from 2021.

The company's September 2016 release says Tiffin-based Webster, founded in Chicago in 1876, employed more than 300 people at plants in Tiffin, Meridian, Mississippi and Portland, Oregon; its Form 5500 shows 373 participants in 2015 and 244 in 2019. Private equity firm MPE Partners invested in 2024, after the grant years.

Sky Climber Fabricating LLC (formed April 2016, per Bizapedia) shares Sky Climber, LLC's address at 1600 Pittsburgh Dr., Delaware, Ohio; LinkedIn lists the privately held Sky Climber group at 201-500 employees and RocketReach at about 200. The 2018-2019 headcount was not found, and Sky Climber's other affiliates abroad may add staff.
